item.title: Heng Li Lang | Integral Conversation
item.description: Heng Li Lang joined Temasek Foundation in 2017, spearheading the development of scalable, high-impact solutions through collective action and cross-sector collaboration.

item.title: Geoff Erik Li | Integral Conversation
item.description: Pianist Geoff Erik Li, born in Hong Kong and resides in Chiangmai, studied under the late Dr. William Black at the College Conservatory of Music of the University of Cincinnati and graduated from the HKBU and HKAPA under the tutelage of Mr. Hung Chong and Professor Gabriel Kwok majoring in piano performance.

item.title: Daniel Zhang | Integral Conversation
item.description: Daniel Zhang is the managing partner of Firstlight Capital. Prior to joining the fund, he served as chief executive officer of Alibaba Group from 2015 and its chairman from 2019 until 2023. He was also a founding member of the Alibaba Partnership.

item.title: Paulo Pong | Integral Conversation
item.description: Paulo Pong is the Founder and Managing Director of Altaya Group which is an exclusive importer and distributor of internationally-acclaimed wine brands, a retailer and a provider of wine investment services in Hong Kong and Mainland China.

item.title: Christine Loh | Integral Conversation
item.description: Professor Christine Loh, SBS, JP, OBE, Chevalier de l’Ordre National du Mérite, is Chief Development Strategist at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. She was Under Secretary for the Environment in the HKSAR Government (2012-17), Special Consultant to the Chief Executive on the mainland’s ecological civilisation policy (2019-2020), and a Member of the Hong Kong Legislative Council (1992-97 and 1998-2000). She has been active in public policy and politics since the 1980s. She founded and was the CEO of the non-profit think tank, Civic Exchange (2000-12), and helped to establish several non-profit organizations in Hong Kong related to the environment, equal opportunity, as well as arts and culture.

item.title: Christiane Dolva | Integral Conversation
item.description: Christiane Dolva is Head of Innovation, Research & Demonstration at H&M Foundation, where she leads teams working across these areas and sets the strategy and direction for the foundation’s efforts in innovation, research, and demonstration.

item.title: Dan Fishman | Integral Conversation
item.description: Dan Fishman is Vice President of Winemaking and Vineyards at Donum Estate. As an undergraduate at Cornell University, he studied philosophy and psychology with the goal of pursuing a PhD and becoming a professor, until a wine appreciation class changed his trajectory. After his first harvest internship at Donum in 2007, he continued his training in New Zealand at Wither Hills Winery, where his winemaking career began.

item.title: Nisa Leung | Integral Conversation
item.description: Nisa Leung is the Managing Partner of Aulis Capital. Prior to that, she served as Managing Partner at Qiming Venture Partners, where she founded and led the firm's healthcare practice since 2006. Under her leadership, Qiming became a pioneering investor in healthcare and biotech sectors, backing some of the most innovative companies in the industry.

item.title: Irene Lee | Integral Conversation
item.description: Irene Lee is the executive chairman of Hysan Development Limited and an independent director of Alibaba Group Holding Limited.

item.title: Lillian Kiang | Integral Conversation
item.description: Lillian Kiang is Chief Executive Officer of Bei Shan Tang Foundation. An alumna of MIT and Harvard Business School, she spent nearly two decades in finance, working at Goldman Sachs and Merrill Lynch before serving as Director of Investment at Temasek Holdings and Deputy Chief Manager at CK Asset Holdings. While helping businesses grow was rewarding, her passion for education through volunteer work inspired her to transition into philanthropy. In 2020, she joined Bei Shan Tang Foundation as its newly created role, where she manages the foundation’s financial investments and applies her investment acumen to drive greater social impact, fostering a more inclusive and flourishing future for the next generation.

item.title: William Chan | Integral Conversation
item.description: William Chan is currently the Head of Foundation & Community of Y.L. Yang Foundation. The Foundation is committed to providing charitable programs in innovative learning, sustainability education and child health for underprivileged children in China, Hong Kong and Vietnam.

item.title: Royce YC Hong | Integral Conversation
item.description: Designer by training and entrepreneur by circumstance, Royce YC Hong is Founder & CEO of XING Mobility, the company behind Taiwan’s first electric supercar and the world’s first mass-produced immersion-cooled battery system—powering next-generation EVs, industrial machinery, renewable energy storage, and AI data centers. He is also Founder and Chairman of IPEVO, an innovator in AI-powered communication tools with more than 60% penetration in U.S. K-12 schools, and serves as Chairman of Panasonic Taiwan, a six-decade market leader in home appliances and electronic components.

item.title: Wang Tianyi | Integral Conversation
item.description: Professor Tianyi Wang is Professor of Practice at City University of Hong Kong’s College of Business, Academic Chair of the Investment and Financing Research Center at Tsinghua University, and Council Member of the Integral Institute. He is also a member of the China Council for International Cooperation on Environment and Development (CCICED).

item.title: Teresa Yang | Integral Conversation
item.description: Teresa Yang is the Vice Chairman of Esquel Group, a knowledge-based innovation company that continuously pushes for positive change in the textile and apparel business, expanding into new territory to evolve with the industry and its customers.

item.title: Edgar Tung | Integral Conversation
item.description: Edgar Tung is the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Tessellation Group. He is a seasoned executive with more than 25 years of solid general management experience in different industries, including technology, quality assurance as well as food and beverage retailing.

item.title: Hau Lee | Integral Conversation
item.description: Professor Hau Lee is a highly respected leader whose expertise lies in global supply chain management and value chain innovations. He is also interested in how innovating with the value chain can bring forth economic and welfare development in developing economies. He was inducted to the US National Academy of Engineering, and has been elected a Fellow of MSOM, POMS, and INFORMS.
